messages:
aisha (product): Quick kickoff — customers asking for a single-pane view that ties cost + errors + trace hotspots. Need to decide scope for Q2.
liam (eng-obs): +1. We should avoid building a massive dashboard first. Proposal: 3 panels — cost by route, error rate by model/version, top trace spans by p99 latency.
rhea (sre): Also need alerting hooks. If p99 latency > 2s for >5% of requests for 10m, we should auto-create an incident draft.
sanjay (data): For cost signal, what granularity? Per-route token counts are heavy. We can do per-minute aggregates with tags (route, model, customer-tier). Cheap and usable for SLO gating.
jen (solutions): Customers pushed for rollout criteria: must be able to pin a customer to dedicated routing & get their cost/error delta before/after. So we need a customer compare view.
liam (eng-obs): Implementation note: traces + costs join on request_id. We need a KV-cache to store the mapping for 24h to avoid windowed joins. Also sampling considerations — if we sample traces, join suffers.
aisha (product): Sampling tradeoff is critical. Customers expect accurate hotspot lists. Can we offer two modes: sample-10% default, and a customer-eligible full-sample for Dedicated/Private?
rhea (sre): Agree. Default sample + synthetic extrapolation for counts. For launch gating: require error regressions to be within 5% relative to baseline on sampled metrics, AND no >10% spike in any customer segment.
sanjay (data): Quick config snippet for sampling policy we prototyped:
```
trace_sampling:
  default: 0.10
  overrides:
    dedicated_customer: 1.0
    critical_routes: 0.5
```
liam (eng-obs): Love the snippet. For dashboards: make the trace-hotspots panel compute per-span p95/p99 and show delta_vs_baseline inline. Backend returns: span, p95, p99, delta_pct. Frontend displays sparkline + delta badge.
jen (solutions): For customer asks, record two acceptance checks: 1) customer compare shows pre/post delta for cost & error, 2) can pin a customer and see raw traces for a 1h window.
aisha (product): Can we define launch criteria checklist (MVP) — minimal and stretch?
liam (eng-obs): MVP checklist:
- Panels: cost-by-route, error-rate-by-model, trace-hotspots (sampled)
- Sampling policy implemented and documented
- Canary: route-level rollout to 5% traffic with observable delta
- Alerts: incident draft on p99/err spikes
Stretch:
- Customer-compare view
- Full-sample option for Dedicated
rhea (sre): Add: instrumentation tests (end-to-end: trace join + dashboard visual smoke test) and runbook template.
sanjay (data): Metrics cost estimate: ~200k series/month for default sampling; Dedicated customers add linear overhead. We should add a pricing note for storage/retention.
aisha (product): Prioritization request: can we scope MVP for Q2 beta? If not, push core visuals and sampling for Q2, customer-compare as Q3.
liam (eng-obs): Feasible if we scope backend to aggregated endpoints first. UI can use placeholders for customer-compare.
jen (solutions): I'll collect top 3 paying customers who asked for compare feature to prioritize Dedicated gating.
aisha (product): Great. Action items: @liam own backend proto, @sanjay provide series cost estimate by EOD Fri, @jen gather customer list, @rhea draft runbook checklist. I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday to lock scope.
deploy-bot: New meeting created: "Observability gating sync" — Fri 10:30am. :calendar:
